reader_summary.headline: Happy New Year, everyone, and welcome back to the A16Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Happy New Year, everyone, and welcome back to the A16Z podcast. This is your host, Staff Smith, and today I am delighted to share what I think is an incredibly relevant episode for this audience. In this episode, Sonal Choxy and A16C crypto, founding general partner, Chris Dixon, sit down with Bob Eiger, yes, the Bob Iger, longtime CEO of Disney.

thesis: The episode argues that managing creatives requires understanding that ideas are tied to their self-esteem and establishing a sincere partnership rather than exerting authority. It further contends that executives must avoid dismissing creators' perspectives or adding to their anxiety, instead offering advice without ordering changes to maintain a benign presence.
